purpose: Independent flat digital content for actual folded-corner LED and smaller content-studio displays. These files are not screenshots or photographs of the reference hall.
processing: Original PNGs retained. Runtime WebP siblings encoded by Sharp quality96 effort6. No pixel cropping, compositing or perspective distortion baked into the assets.

suggested_crops.coordinate_convention: Normalized source-image coordinates with origin at top-left. These are suggestions for runtime UV/fit mapping; source pixels remain uncropped.

acceptance: The existing close-match main artwork is preserved. New secondary assets are reference-guided reconstructions, not asserted to be pixel-identical copies. Hall architecture, branding, frames, furniture and visitors must remain separate actual 3D/runtime objects.
